testsuite.name: new artist contract, classified review and free services in isolated MySQL

pending historical creation is not silently replaced and can finish its original payment
free hosting is perpetual and deduplicates simultaneous requests without money records
free creation failure records no refund, requires independent operator and is retryable
free archive needs owned files and both face and voice; never enables a provider model
free routes still enforce minor restrictions and cancellation does not create money
new certification refuses missing categories, wrong files and another owner assets
supplement replaces classified snapshot, preserves original evidence and consumes one fee
new fee cannot be refunded; previous contract remains refundable
withdrawing a new application consumes its review, keeps evidence and grants no certification
copyright is an exclusive choice and never transfers personality or third party assets
manual sample commissioner is not substituted for the person whose rights are reserved
personal finished-film license does not become commercial distribution permission

testsuite.name: contract release mode blocks new old-rule quotes but preserves approved historical promises

pending legacy quote cannot gain approval after cutover
already approved quote can still be accepted without rewriting original hours or 30/60/10
historical specification remains publishable for old-order amendments but cannot create a new ordinary quote
new calendar specification quotes, independent review and contract snapshot use actual HTTP
omitting product identity and story cannot bypass cutover through the legacy production quote path
expired reviewed calendar cannot form or approve a new quote
outsider cannot use the release setting to issue platform quotes
mixed results commit independently and rejected result survives reopen
same request and lost receipt replay do not repeat assignment; changed payload rejected
parallel retries return one batch and one business mutation
foreign accounts, personal identities, invalid batches and revoked membership

testsuite.name: organization merchandise batch isolated MySQL and HTTP

price change creates a reviewable new specification without changing listing or old price

revoked artist authorization hides receipts and prevents replay

actual audition catalogue removes private prices from budget matches and closed booking from results
artist matching uses current invitation context then independent review and one support case
notice matching supplies actual authorized submission choices; closed notice blocks stale selection
matching uses explicit public prices and license rights, never unknown prices or automatic authorization
artist tags and levels / notice types cannot be silently replaced with unrelated filters
scan limit permits subsequent pages, cursor binds account and every condition without reading history

testsuite.name: personal trade copies preserve receipts, refunds and historical contracts

gross and refund facts remain separate; no provider secrets or false completion
redacted contract has its own checksum; source stays unchanged and unsigned
scope, account and cursor isolation apply to every request
corrupt records and inconsistent journal fail closed
unknown payment and requested refund never become received or refunded money
creation, cancellation and payment deadline are actual recorded facts, not settlement timestamps
source quotation uses frozen terms and rejects cross-order parent substitution
disabled account is rechecked, reads do not complete the privacy request

testsuite.name: real isolated MySQL persists provider status, evidence and concurrent edits

testcase.name: database readiness requires applied migrations, not just a connection
recording is denied by default and requires genuine server-side evidence checking
configuration is saved but does not authorize real calls
verified evidence survives closing and reopening the database connection
disabling and awaiting approval keep history but block new calls
two concurrent updates cannot overwrite each other silently
history write failure rolls back both status and version
re-enabling requires fresh evidence and preserves earlier verification
capabilities have separate status even for the same provider

testsuite.name: received stock orders, refunds and returned rewards preserve original point debts

testcase.name: independently reviewed wallet and new 48-hour stock terms, zero initial points
two fresh paid orders earn nothing before real content read and buyer acceptance
mature original order issues once under its captured rule; concurrent sync does not duplicate
a real reward exchange consumes four points once and retains original expiry
full cash refund succeeds despite spent points; debt prevents new exchange without using stock
later order earnings clear earlier debt without erasing the new consumption growth
refunding the replacement earning creates its own shortage; free check-in pays debt without adding growth
independent reward remedy returns original spent points once, clears remaining debt and cannot resurrect growth
